assessment: This paper will be of interest to readers studying the neuronal circuit in general and those studying the basolateral amygdala (BLA), prefrontal cortex (PFC), and diseases associated with these regions. Using innovative circuit analysis techniques, this important paper shows that different subregions of the BLA form cell-type-specific connections with the subregion of PFC and engage specific local circuits within it. The key claim of the paper is supported by compelling data from multiple approaches.
